cyd32-st7798.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 CYD 3.2 R14.36 LAB — SquachWatch v1.50 Coverage (248 Cases)
cyd32-st7798.summary: R14.36 LAB compares the pinned SquachWatch v1.50.0 detection library and expands SquachEmit from 172 to 248 synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi cases (66 added). Corrects 24 outdated expected labels, adds 22 OUI beacons, 24 SSID fixtures, 9 BLE UUID, 4 manufacturer and 7 special BLE payload cases. New categories include ALPR, CAMERA, RING, LISTENER and GOOGLE_TAG. Source matrix maps 105 of 220 explicit v1.50 table entries to candidate tests. Preserves R14.33 battery calibration and animations. Four-part SHA-256 packaging. Hardware reception NOT verified. Includes ten Sq Physical RF receiver validation pending.
highlights: 66 new v1.50.0-derived synthetic signal fixtures, 248 total; original 172 stable IDs preserved. Includes 10 fork-only OUI tests.
24 stale expected results corrected; negative-control detection prevents false positives.
Camera/dashcam, Ring, ALPR, Listener, Google Find Hub, HomePod and AirTag tests added.
22 temporary source-matched vendor-prefix AP MACs with synthetic suffixes; not authentic devices.
14 alphabetic test libraries, source-pinned 105/220 table-rule candidate coverage matrix.
Buffered CYD 3.2 animation, R14.33 calibrated %/V and original 172 RF profiles retained.
LAB only; four-part SHA-256 flash packaging; physical SquachWatch receiver test pending.

c5-waveshare-28.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 Waveshare C5 R14.36 LAB — v1.50 Coverage (248 Cases)
c5-waveshare-28.summary: R14.36 LAB shares the full 248-case synthetic BLE/Wi-Fi catalog and 14 device categories with the CYD3.2 and S3: 66 new SquachWatch v1.50 signal fixtures, 24 corrected expected classifications and a pinned signature-source audit. All 248 are manual, bounded TEST/RUN/STOP scenarios. Does not claim LoRaWAN or Wi-Fi deauth/EvilTwin validation. Four-part SHA-256 flashing preflight. Physical C5 verification pending. Includes ten SquachWatch fork-only OUI fixture tests (Flock, drones, skimmer and Flipper). Physical receiver verification pending.
highlights: 248 bounded BLE and Wi-Fi synthetic test cases; 66 new v1.50 fixtures.
24 expected-label corrections and source-pinned signature matrix.
14 alphabetically sorted device test categories.
No actual vendor/device authentication; restricted to normal BLE and Wi-Fi test frames.
Serial truth reporting and manual STOP preserved.
Four-part SHA-256 preflight; no physical C5 verification yet.
10 fork-only OUI beacons added; parent v1.50.0 rule matrix remains separately source-pinned.

s3-devkit.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 ESP32-S3 R14.36 LAB — v1.50 Coverage (248 Cases)

Four-part SHA-256 verified flashing preflight; physical S3 verification pending. Includes ten SquachWatch fork-only OUI fixture tests (Flock, drones, skimmer and Flipper). Physical receiver verification pending.
